results.verdict: Go live. The eight new fronts render light C exactly as the owner chose it. Ember and Fog are byte-for-byte the S1 test 'c' frames he picked from. My own count of the masks gives 0 equipment px and 0 hidden px. Neither 1:1 nor 3x shows fireflies, blotches or banding, and every change from the live fronts comes from refraction, caustics or removing the painted contact term. Two things should be recorded. First, a decision on the five shadowless reflect-only flags (S4, also in the live fronts). Second, commit the NO GLASS SHADOWS logs.

findings.tints: all eight (and the 192 turn frames, which use the same set)
findings.claim: The rule 'every object casts shadows' fails on five set flags in every front. They are reflect-only: they cast no shadow, take no diffuse light, are invisible to transmitted rays and are one-sided. Light C did not change them, so a ray that has passed through the acrylic still sees lit paper where a real black card stands.
findings.evidence: front-<tint>.json set.flags[0,1,2,3,5] carry 'reflect_only': true. They sit at (1.6,2.05,0.005) 1.6x2.9 m, (1.8,2.1,1.3) 3.0x2.6, (1.92,-1.44,1.2) 2.4x2.4, (0,-0.6,2.6) 2.5x2.0 and (0,-1.0,2.2) 2.0x1.2. studio/engine/sets.py:180-184 turns off their shadow, diffuse, transmission and volume visibility, keeps glossy on and makes them one-sided. The same five are in the live source (studio-refresh shot), so they are inherited, not new. They are out of frame: 0% by projection (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-super-hot/f4a25b5c-7cd5-585d-b4f3-c7ba36b6c676/scratchpad/b83/physics/rig_table.txt) and 0 px of id 255 in every mask. The 21 Nov audit confirmed this as low severity (coordinator/acrylic-light-audit-2026-11-21.json, lane 1, S4: 'a veil of a few L* on Fog's upper right face, perhaps up to about 6 ... Nothing here is measured'). The size of the effect is still UNVERIFIED because no S4 test render exists. light-c/README.md nonetheless calls C 'one physical light model'. Fix: set reflect_only false with every ray on (the flags are out of frame), or record an explicit exception the way the paper-only lamps were kept. Any fix means re-rendering the 8 fronts and the 192 turn frames.

findings.claim: The record's 'NO GLASS SHADOWS 6' (24 Nov 06:27) rests on logs that were never committed. Nothing on the branch shows the count, or shows that no shadow-ray link was left.
findings.evidence: run.sh writes /tmp/lightc-$n.log and only echoes a grep of it. front-<tint>.report.json has no such field. The shots carry no living_ext.shadow_ray_report, which the B1 bar runs did include ('shadow-ray links left 0'). By construction the cut should be complete: materials.py:1238 (_clear_resin) is the engine's only 'Is Shadow Ray' link, and living_ext.py:75-102 cuts exactly that Mix-with-Transparent pattern (Fac set to 0, keeping the Principled BSDF). The count of 6 matches s1-test/README.md ('6 materials') and the six clear_resin-type materials the product defs declare: barkhorn-cloud.json bark, horn-formed, horn-satin; barkhorn-variants.json bark, clear-cast, horn-lot. The count itself is UNVERIFIED. Fix: commit the eight logs, or add shadow_ray_report after no_glass_shadows (no pixel changes).

findings.claim: All eight were rendered with light C's settings, and those settings are the only change from the live fronts.
findings.evidence: Every front-<tint>.json has caustics_refractive true, caustics_reflective true, clamp 0, filter_glossy 0.0 and samples 96. Its set has contact strength 0.0 and core_strength 0.0, and props holds only [no_glass_shadows], which is therefore last. In all eight, .shot.json (the resolved shot render.py writes) equals .json, and the report's applied/sets/pending lists are empty. The engine maps clamp to sample_clamp_indirect=0; render.py never sets the direct clamp, which I take to keep Blender's factory 0 (off), as the 21 Nov lamps audit also reads it. filter_glossy maps to blur_glossy=0 (render.py). materials.py:385 adds the painted AO only when contact or core is above 0. Against the live source (renders/2026-11-12/barkhorn/studio-refresh/site-front-off-tall-<tint>.shot.json), only these change: caustics added, clamp 8 to 0, filter_glossy from its 0.5 default to 0, contact 1.7/2.2 to 0, the prop and the title. Ember and Fog are byte-identical to s1-test/ember-c.png and fog-c.png (blobs 8c78e244, 83bcda2d). They were rendered separately (325.7 s vs 685.9 s; 507.0 s vs 1044.2 s) from identical shots and model hashes, so they are exactly the frames the owner chose. The generator lives at spinoffs/barkhorn/campaign/light_c.py, not in the light-c folder.

The masks are pixel-identical across the eight and match the studio-refresh masks (0 px differ). All eight share one mask.json (blob f3263aef). Every report shows exposure -0.1, PBR Neutral, white balance 5600/3.0 and finish gain 1.0. Paper more than 150 px from the product reads L* 90.01-90.08, a* +0.04..+0.17, b* +4.74..+4.94 across the tints. The S1 'a' re-render on the rebuilt model differs from the live source by a mean |d| of 0.048 (Ember) and 0.185 (Fog) per channel. For the other six tints this is inferred from the identical masks.

findings.claim: The 0/0 audit cannot see two things: a real card behind the base that the camera sees through the acrylic, and six zero-power lamps placed inside the frame.

The chroma drop on the bright Dust, Acid and Ice fronts (-5.2 to -7.1) is PBR Neutral's highlight desaturation (Acid predicted 69.0, measured 71.7). A bright refracted patch on the woofer rings moved from about (562-566, 783-788) to (552-560, 810-811) (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-super-hot/f4a25b5c-7cd5-585d-b4f3-c7ba36b6c676/scratchpad/b83/physics/crops/caldera-spot-zoom3.png).

findings.claim: On the right side, Dust's batts turn 6° yellower and Ice's turn 11° toward cyan, more than extra light alone explains. This fits cast acrylic: refraction shortens oblique paths through the dye compared with the old straight shadow rays. How large the shift should be is unverified.
findings.evidence: Dust right audit box goes from h 52.1 to 58.5, with C* 7.1 below the scaled-A prediction (upper batts +6.0°, -7.2). Ice goes from 281.6 to 270.2, with C* 14.0 below prediction (upper -10.9°, -12.7). Haze's C* is 6.3-6.5 below prediction. _clear_resin (materials.py) absorbs each channel at its own rate with Beer-Lambert ('deep' after 'radius'). The 21 Nov audit found the old shortcut mis-weighting direct light with angle ('-10 % at 60 deg, -30 % at 75 deg').
